supersedes: Time watermark alone is insufficient for a fixed cross-request result set.

snapshot_policy.membership: Persist ordered immutable observation/version IDs in one short transaction using one consistent visibility snapshot.
snapshot_policy.binding: actor, current role/policy, normalized filters, sort and paired received_watermark; authenticate every request
snapshot_policy.projection: Immutable observation/version or frozen bounded projection; never silently export a mutable latest result.
snapshot_policy.permission_change: Invalidate the old snapshot; fixed membership does not override revoked access.

concurrency_vector: T1 inserts observation X with received_at before watermark, but remains uncommitted.
First query commits snapshot S without X.
S later pages, total and CSV still exclude X.
A new first query can create a new snapshot containing X.
